# Build wrapper for the vendored pq-crystals/dilithium (FIPS 204 ML-DSA)
# reference implementation. The submodule is pinned to a commit from the
# "update to final standard" series (cf998be); the FIPS 204 API is identified
# by its context-string parameter and TRBYTES=64. Dilithium2/3/5 here are
# ML-DSA-44/65/87 respectively.
#
# The reference sources are compiled as a single translation unit ("unity
# build"). This lets the C compiler inline the hot modular-reduction helpers
# (montgomery_reduce, reduce32, ...) into the NTT routines, which is worth
# roughly a 1.9x speed-up on aarch64. It also avoids depending on whole-program
# LTO being enabled for the final C++ link. No changes are made to the
# vendored sources; the unity file is generated in the build directory.

set(MLDSA_MODE 2 CACHE STRING
    "ML-DSA parameter set: 2 = ML-DSA-44, 3 = ML-DSA-65, 5 = ML-DSA-87")

if(NOT MLDSA_MODE EQUAL 2 AND NOT MLDSA_MODE EQUAL 3 AND NOT MLDSA_MODE EQUAL 5)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "MLDSA_MODE must be one of 2 (ML-DSA-44), 3 (ML-DSA-65), 5 (ML-DSA-87); got ${MLDSA_MODE}")
endif()

set(_mldsa_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../dilithium/ref")
get_filename_component(_mldsa_dir "${_mldsa_dir}" ABSOLUTE)

# Keep in sync with ref/Makefile (KECCAK_SOURCES + randombytes).
set(_mldsa_sources
    sign.c
    packing.c
    polyvec.c
    poly.c
    ntt.c
    reduce.c
    rounding.c
    fips202.c
    symmetric-shake.c
    randombytes.c)

set(_mldsa_unity "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dilithium_unity.c")
file(WRITE "${_mldsa_unity}"
     "/* Generated by CMake: unity build of pq-crystals/dilithium ref. */\n")
foreach(_src IN LISTS _mldsa_sources)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_mldsa_dir}/${_src}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing vendored dilithium source: ${_mldsa_dir}/${_src}")
    endif()
    file(APPEND "${_mldsa_unity}" "#include \"${_src}\"\n")
endforeach()

add_library(mldsa STATIC "${_mldsa_unity}"
                          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mldsa_extra.c")

target_include_directories(mldsa PUBLIC "${_mldsa_dir}")
target_compile_definitions(mldsa PRIVATE DILITHIUM_MODE=${MLDSA_MODE})
# Consumers need to know the parameter set to size the key/signature types.
target_compile_definitions(mldsa PUBLIC MLDSA_MODE=${MLDSA_MODE})

# Best known flags for this workload, validated on aarch64. The unity build is
# what provides the speed-up; -funroll-loops gives a small additional gain.
target_compile_options(mldsa PRIVATE
    -O3
    -funroll-loops
    -fomit-frame-pointer)

# The reference implementation is third-party code built with the project's
# -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror; silence its warnings rather than patching.
target_compile_options(mldsa PRIVATE -w)
